category: Multi-Agent Orchestration Frameworks & Autonomous Agent SDKs

repositories.name: AutoGen (AG2)
repositories.state_checkpointing: Event-driven async actor runtime with distributed state serialization
repositories.primary_strength: Event-driven multi-agent actor runtime (AutoGen v0.4) with distributed code execution
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Conversational group-chat loops amplify token consumption 2.4x without strict turn limits

repositories.name: CrewAI
repositories.state_checkpointing: CrewAI Flows with @persist state decorators and SQLite memory
repositories.primary_strength: Fastest role-based multi-agent prototyping with deterministic Flows and built-in RAG tools
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Opinionated role-prompt wrappers add 1.65x prompt token overhead on simple tool calls

repositories.name: LangGraph
repositories.state_checkpointing: Native Postgres/SQLite state checkpointer with time-travel replay & human-in-the-loop
repositories.primary_strength: Deterministic cyclical state graphs with production time-travel checkpointing and zero hidden prompts
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Steeper learning curve requiring explicit TypedDict state schemas and reducer definitions

repositories.name: Agno (Phidata)
repositories.state_checkpointing: Native Postgres/SqliteAgentStorage with built-in Agent UI and knowledge vector stores
repositories.primary_strength: 3-microsecond agent instantiation and 7KB memory footprint (50x lighter than graph frameworks)
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Complex cyclic branching requires custom Python orchestration compared to LangGraph reducers

repositories.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
repositories.state_checkpointing: Built-in handoffs, input/output guardrails, and native OpenAI Responses API tracing
repositories.primary_strength: Minimalist Python primitives (Agents, Handoffs, Guardrails) with zero-config trace visualization
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Optimized primarily around OpenAI Responses API and lacks built-in durable DB checkpointing

repositories.name: Smolagents
repositories.state_checkpointing: Sandboxed Python CodeAgent execution (E2B / Docker / Pyodide) with step logs
repositories.primary_strength: CodeAgent writes actions directly in Python rather than JSON tool calls, cutting LLM steps by 30%
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Requires secure code execution sandboxing (Docker or E2B) to run untrusted LLM-generated Python
